art_instructions: Draw a cozy, child-level view of the inside of a family house. The owl, a small woodland character with round amber eyes and mottled brown-and-cream feathers, is perched on a low wooden bed with a green scarf tied at her neck. She is stretching her wings and blinking sleepily as she wakes up. Her tiny satchel rests on the bed beside her. The background shows soft cream curtains, a small window letting in warm morning light, and simple wooden furniture like a low dresser and a child-sized table just out of frame. A gentle, soft pastel color palette is used with warm browns and cream tones.
